# Bagback Download — Public Showcase Repository

> Enterprise-grade universal media download manager. Built with React 19 PWA, Express 5, TypeScript strict mode. Monorepo architecture with a type-safe mock layer for public demonstration.

## Project

- Type: Open-source showcase / portfolio project
- Author: Mohamed Osama (Digital Transformation Architect, Bagback Digital Solutions)
- License: MIT
- Repository: https://github.com/mohamedosamaai/bagback-download-showcase
- Live Demo: https://mohamedosamaai.github.io/bagback-download-showcase?mock=true

## Architecture

- Pattern: Clean Architecture + Monorepo (npm workspaces)
- Frontend: React 19, TypeScript strict, Vite 5, PWA (Workbox)
- Backend: Node.js 22, Express 5, TypeScript, Server-Sent Events
- Containerization: Docker multi-stage build (Alpine, < 180MB)
- CI/CD: GitHub Actions (type-check, build, CodeQL security scan)

## Key Engineering Concepts Demonstrated

- Type-safe service interface with Real/Mock implementations
- Server-Sent Events for real-time progress streaming
- PWA with offline capability via Workbox GenerateSW
- Arabic/English i18n with RTL/LTR support
- Rate limiting, auto-cleanup jobs, path traversal protection
- Zero-secret dual-repository architecture

- Wiki: https://github.com/mohamedosamaai/bagback-download-showcase/wiki

## Files

- README.md: Executive summary with architecture diagram
- apps/web/src/lib/api.ts: DownloadService interface + Real/Mock implementations
- apps/web/src/mocks/handlers.ts: Platform-specific mock metadata generator
- apps/server/src/index.ts: Express API with sanitized mock engine
- tools/showcase-generator.ps1: Reusable repository sanitizer script
